schema_validation.note: The requested schema file was not present in the repository, so this artifact uses the prompt-defined structure without schema-backed validation.

findings.title: Schema-backed artifact validation is still missing, which weakens machine-checkable review discipline
evidence: The requested schema file `schemas/adversarial_review.schema.json` is still not present in the repository.
The confidence step still records that `schemas/confidence_report.schema.json` is missing as well.
Without the schema files, PSTF artifact structure cannot be validated mechanically even though the prompts require schema conformance.
findings.suggested_action: Add the missing schema files or document the canonical JSON structures in-repo so future PSTF artifacts can be validated automatically.

findings.title: The confidence gate still cannot clear threshold because no module coverage artifact exists for the touched code
evidence: `verification_report.md` now verifies all approved non-rollback acceptance criteria, but `confidence_report.json` still scores code coverage at `0.0` because no coverage artifact exists.
Under the current scoring formula, the feature cannot reach the `0.90` threshold without either coverage evidence or an explicit policy exception.
No `coverage.out`, LCOV, or equivalent touched-module coverage report is present in the repository for this slice.
findings.suggested_action: Generate module coverage evidence for the touched backend and web suites or record an explicit exception before claiming the confidence gate is satisfied.
